title: Authentication event (identity-provider sign-in telemetry for identity-compromise response)
summary: OCSF Authentication events the identity-compromise playbook consumes when an identity-protection signal lands. Carries principal identity, source endpoint and geolocation, MFA outcome, logon type, and session identifiers used by triage (impossible-travel / MFA-bypass interpretation) and by session-revocation accounting.
sources: OCSF v1.4.0 Identity & Access Management category — Authentication class (uid 3002)
